## 🚀 GITHUB RELEASE PUBLICATION

### Step-by-Step Instructions

**1. Navigate to GitHub Releases**
   - Go to: https://github.com/KallokTherok1994/TITANE_-LITE/releases
   - Or: GitHub → Code → Releases (right sidebar)

**2. Click "Draft a new release"**
   - Button location: Top-right of releases page

**3. Select Tag**
   - Tag version: **`v27.1.0`** ✅ (already exists)
   - Target: **`MAIN`** ✅ (already points to correct branch)

**4. Fill Release Information**
   - **Release title:** `🚀 TITANE LITE v27.1.0 - Massive Optimization System`
   - **Description:** Copy entire content from [GITHUB_RELEASE_TEMPLATE_v27_1_0.md](GITHUB_RELEASE_TEMPLATE_v27_1_0.md)

**5. Set Options**
   - ☑️ Set as "Latest Release" (check this)
   - Optional: Generate release notes (GitHub can auto-generate)

**6. Publish Release**
   - Click "Publish release" button
   - Release becomes publicly visible
